# Trippy

> Trippy is a free collaborative group trip planner for friends and families.

## What Trippy Does

Trippy gives a group of travelers one shared space to plan a trip together in real time. Members can:

- Build a **day-by-day itinerary** (activities, hotels, transport, restaurants)
- Track a **group budget** — log expenses and split costs fairly
- See all stops on a **live interactive map**
- Manage a **shared packing list** synced across the whole group
- Invite crew members via **shareable link** — no app download required
- Get **AI-powered suggestions** for places, budget tips, and packing advice

## Key Facts

- **Price:** Free. No credit card required.
- **Platform:** Web app (Progressive Web App). Works on any browser, phone or desktop.
- **Sign-in:** Google OAuth (name and email only)
- **Languages:** English and Hebrew (bilingual)
- **Real-time sync:** All changes visible to the group instantly
- **Privacy:** User data never sold. Row-level security. Account deletion available any time.

## Who It's For

Groups of friends, families, or colleagues planning trips together — weekend escapes to month-long adventures.
